esp32-default.guide: Download your board's firmware binaries from GitHub Releases and flash them using an ESP32 flasher.

esp32s3-default.guide: Download your board's firmware binaries from GitHub Releases and flash them using an ESP32 flasher.

esp32s31-default.guide: The ESP32-S31 preview environment does not publish firmware yet. Build it locally with pio run -e esp32s31-default.

waveshare-s3-lcd21b.guide: Download your board's firmware binaries from GitHub Releases and flash them using an ESP32 flasher.

esp32-cyd-28.guide: Install this build over USB once. OTA needs two app slots, so the CYD has to be reflashed by wire to get the new partition table; every update after that arrives in place. Use the GitHub Releases page for this fork, not the upstream flasher.
